title: AstraVitals Clinician Threshold Rules Schema
description: Clinician-editable threshold configuration for the interpretation engine.

normal_ranges.description: Per-metric normal ranges [min, max] in clinician-chosen units.

warning_buffer_percent.description: Percentage buffer beyond normal range that triggers YELLOW (Watch) status.

critical_multiplier.description: Multiplier beyond normal + warning that triggers RED (Critical) status.

additionalProperties.description: Number of recent readings to consider for trend analysis per metric.

trend_windows.description: Rolling window sizes per metric for trend/drift analysis.

escalate_if_yellow_count.description: If this many metrics are YELLOW simultaneously, escalate the next to RED.

require_medical_officer_alert.description: Whether to require Medical Officer notification on combined escalation.

additionalProperties.description: Plain-language guidance for GREEN status per metric.
Plain-language guidance for YELLOW status per metric.
Plain-language guidance for RED status per metric.

guidance_templates.description: Clinician-editable guidance text per status/metric combination.
